Akash Singh | akash.singh940@example.com | +91 9960011704
Bangalore. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Bangalore only. Notice period: 90 days.

Experienced backend engineer focused on building scalable services, APIs and data-backed features using Python and cloud platforms.

Backend Engineer, Accenture — Feb 2026 - Present
Led development of internal microservices for client finance platform using Python and Django; implemented complex data ingestion flows into PostgreSQL and built API endpoints for reporting. Optimized slow queries and indexing strategies in PostgreSQL, reducing report generation times by ~40%. Collaborated in Agile sprints via Jira and deployed services on Linux-based CI runners.

Backend Engineer, Swiggy — Feb 2024 - Jan 2026
Designed and maintained backend services for order orchestration using Python and Django; created resilient REST APIs consumed by mobile and partner apps. Migrated select services to AWS (EC2, S3, RDS) improving availability and enabling autoscaling during peak loads. Used Jira for sprint planning and worked within Agile teams.

Backend Engineer, Orbit Health — Nov 2021 - Jan 2024
Built and supported patient data services with REST APIs using Python and Django; modeled clinical data in PostgreSQL and implemented caching with Redis to reduce read latency by ~60%. Deployed services to AWS (ECS, RDS) and maintained Linux servers. Participated in Agile ceremonies and tracked work in Jira.

Skills: Python, Django, PostgreSQL, AWS, REST APIs, Redis, Jira, Agile, Linux

Education: MCA, Symbiosis
